tasks.label: CMake: configure
args: case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) BD=build/darwin ;; Linux) BD=build/linux ;; *) BD=build/$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') ;; esac; cmake -S "${workspaceFolder}" -B "${workspaceFolder}/${BD}" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON

tasks.label: CMake: build
args: case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) BD=build/darwin ;; Linux) BD=build/linux ;; *) BD=build/$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') ;; esac; cmake --build "${workspaceFolder}/${BD}" --config Debug --target life_worlds && ln -sfn "${workspaceFolder}/${BD}/compile_commands.json" "${workspaceFolder}/compile_commands.json"

tasks.label: Run life_worlds
args: case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) BD=build/darwin ;; Linux) BD=build/linux ;; *) BD=build/$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') ;; esac; "${workspaceFolder}/${BD}/life_worlds"

tasks.label: Run life_worlds (console)
args: case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) BD=build/darwin ;; Linux) BD=build/linux ;; *) BD=build/$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') ;; esac; "${workspaceFolder}/${BD}/life_worlds" --console
